rationale: Moncler PLP content is SPA-rendered and often delayed by the OneTrust cookie banner and locale/country gating. The failure indicates no product tiles materialized; this is likely due to waiting on the wrong selectors and/or not dismissing modals. The patch adds robust PLP container/tile selectors (data-testid/product-card/itemtype=Product), modal selectors for OneTrust and country overlays, and en-int URL normalization to avoid locale traps. Incremental scrolling helps trigger lazy-loaded tiles. PDP fallbacks use schema.org price/title where possible for resilience.
code_hints: Before navigating to PLP, normalize URL to /en-int and append forceLocale=en-int&shipToCountry=GB if missing.
After navigation, immediately click OneTrust accept if present (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler).
Wait for any of: [data-testid='product-list'], [data-component*='product-list'], or at least one [itemtype*='Product'].
If no tiles after first wait, perform incremental scroll (5–6 steps, ~1200px with 600ms pauses) and retry tile detection.
Extract PDP URL from within tile using a[href$='.html'] to avoid non-product links.
On PDP, prefer meta[itemprop='price'] for stable price retrieval; fallback to [data-testid*='price'].
Set Accept-Language header to en-GB to reduce unwanted locale redirects.
Guard against unexpected redirects: if response URL host is not moncler.com, abort and retry with normalized URL.
